bio: Tokyo street style: layers, sneakers and the little details people walk past. Always one outfit, always the rain.
avatar: Portrait of a person in their mid 20s with a sleek bob haircut dyed charcoal, oversized jacket, neon signs blurred behind them, calm expression, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a rainy Tokyo crossing at night with neon signs and umbrellas, subject across the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: Tokyo after the rain
videos: Layers: a Harajuku outfit, step by step

videos.title: Shibuya crossing, umbrellas
videos.description: A crossing in the rain, umbrellas flowing like a river.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a busy rainy Tokyo crossing at night seen from above with many transparent umbrellas and neon reflections on wet asphalt, no readable text
videos.motion: People cross in waves with umbrellas, rain streaks fall and neon reflections shimmer, slow camera drift.

videos.title: Layers: a Harajuku outfit, step by step
videos.description: Oversize jacket, wide trousers, one loud pair of sneakers.
videos.still: Vertical full-length photograph of a person seen from behind in layered streetwear with oversized jacket and bright sneakers walking down a Tokyo alley, no face, no readable text
videos.motion: The person walks slowly away down the alley, jacket sways, lights glow softly, steady camera follows.

videos.title: Vending machine glow, 2 a.m.
videos.description: A vending machine casting colour on an empty alley.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a glowing vending machine in a quiet narrow Tokyo alley at 2am with wet pavement reflections, no people, no readable text
videos.motion: Light flickers softly on the wet pavement and a faint mist drifts, slow push-in.

videos.title: Sneaker wall, Ura-Hara
videos.description: Rows of sneakers on a wall and a hand picking one pair.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a shop wall with rows of colourful sneakers, a hand reaching for a pair, soft shop lighting, no face, no readable text or logos
videos.motion: The hand lifts a sneaker from the wall, light glints across the rows, subtle slow pan.
